authorityContracts.JobApplication: Sole authority for applicant-visible status, history, original consent and frozen submitted evidence. permittedRecruiterStatuses is owned by its existing lifecycle service and also drives the linked view metadata.
authorityContracts.RecruiterShortlist: Internal notes and stage only. No automatic application synchronization. Shortlisted/contacted/interview/rejected internal stages never notify the Developer.
authorityContracts.RecruiterMatch: Existing public matching authority. No new status model, states, ATS, notification provider, worker or queue.
authorityContracts.permissions: Application-origin disclosure stays owner-only under existing live actor/org/membership/settings/job/application policy and transaction fences. Team/evaluation sharing grants no private application access. Current job ownership and immutable original application ownership must both match; neither party gains access after a mismatched transfer.

apiChanges.additions: page and limit query parameters; meta.page, meta.total, meta.pages. Existing shortlists, meta.scope and meta.limit retained. Default page=1/limit=100; strict positive integer limit<=100, page<=1000000; invalid or unknown query shapes rejected with 400.
apiChanges.ordering: updatedAt descending, _id ascending; each request is a transaction snapshot. Concurrent edits may move records between offset pages; no multi-request snapshot is promised.

apiChanges.additions: application.permittedStatuses and access.manageApplicationStatus. Submitted permits reviewing/rejected; reviewing permits rejected; withdrawn/rejected permit none.

apiChanges.change: Existing endpoint reused without a new route or request contract. UI always supplies observed expectedStatus. Lifecycle service remains the only status/history/notification writer; shortlist service retains only its accepted access fences.

uiChanges: Existing shortlist card renders distinct applicant-visible status action buttons and internal-stage controls; only server-permitted application actions are offered to authorized owners.
Application rejection requires explicit confirmation, with cancellation and stale-source guards. Job Applicants uses the same existing confirmation component.

Successful application actions reload canonical evaluations; 403/404/409 reload and clear stale records, and 409 never silently replays the requested transition. Late source/page/job responses cannot paint another context.

Application feed uses 20 rows per UI page, previous/next navigation, total/page indicators, out-of-range recovery and loading/error/retry/empty/success states. Existing search, filters and metrics are explicitly page-local.
Exact application/evidence links are retained beyond the applicant-list cap. Existing responsive button/group/card styles and theme tokens are reused; public workflows remain unchanged.

paginationAndQueryPlan.implementation: One Mongo aggregation with owner/org match, indexed owned-Job and immutable-source Application joins, original-consent and lifecycle validity checks, canonical SHA-256 key validation, then a rows/count facet. Node receives at most limit rows; no per-row database requests. Only returned page jobs/applications receive the existing batched write fences.
paginationAndQueryPlan.integrity: Native aggregation SHA-256 expression is specialized to the existing 49-byte ObjectId:ObjectId key. Tested against Node crypto vectors and 125 random canonical links; forged valid-looking hashes, missing links, wrong applicant/job/org/owner, invalid consent/date/boolean/status are excluded before totals. No server-side JavaScript, schema field or competing identity introduced.
paginationAndQueryPlan.bounds: At most 100 rows per API page; aggregation maxTimeMS=5000 fails closed, with no partial success. Exact totals and canonical-key checks still perform server work proportional to the scoped owner population; the fixture is not a production capacity claim.
paginationAndQueryPlan.sort: Explicit deterministic tie-break sort; 54934 bytes sorted, usedDisk=false, spills=0 in retained plan.
paginationAndQueryPlan.indexes: Existing organizationId/recruiterId indexes on Shortlist and Job; existing jobId/applicantId unique application index. Foreign joins show zero collection scans. No declaration, migration or production index operation added; this small plan does not justify a new index.

notificationConsistency.mechanism: Accepted P1.1B lifecycle notification transaction and permanent event receipts are reused unchanged.
notificationConsistency.results: Five concurrent observed reviewing intents produce one 200 and four 409s, one notification, one receipt and one inbox revision. Stale/rejected/withdrawn intents do not create success notifications. Internal note/interview-stage changes create none.
notificationConsistency.atomicity: Injected failure after the real notification write rolls back application status/history, receipt, inbox notification and revision together. Concurrent rejection/withdrawal has one winner and one 409, without reopening.
notificationConsistency.privacy: Notification title/message/meta contain no private notes, applicant evidence or application identifiers. Original resume bytes, metadata, portfolio and consent remain unchanged.
notificationConsistency.durability: Unmodified broader production notification assertions passed: cross-worker delivery, inbox-deletion tombstones, restart/reconnect, scope/session revocation, Mongo outage recovery, preference and account deletion contracts.
